G1138.def:
**Δαυείδ** (Rec. Δαβίδ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. דָּוִד),
**David**, King of Israel: [[Mat.1.6; 12.3|Mat.1:6; 12:3]], and al.; σκηνὴ Δ., [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]] κλεὶς Δ., [[Rev.3.7|Rev.3:7]] θρόνος Δ., [[Luk.1.32|Luk.1:32]] ῥίζα Δ., [[Rev.5.5|Rev.5:5]] βασιλεία Δ., [[Mrk.11.10|Mrk.11:10]] υἱὸς Δ., the Messiah (Ps. Sol., 17:23; for other reff. in Jewish lit., see Dalman, _Words_, 317), [[Mat.1.1; 9.27|Mat.1:1 9:27]], and al.; ἐν Δ., i.e. the Psalter, [[Heb.4.7|Heb.4:7]]
(AS)

G1161.def:
**δέ** (before vowels δ᾽; on the general neglect of the elision in NT, see WH, _App._, 146; Tdf., _Pr._, 96),
_post-positive conjunctive particle_;
1. copulative, **but, in the next place, and, now** (Abbott, **JG**, 104): [[Mat.1.2|Mat.1:2]]ff., [[2Co.6.15, 16|2Co.6:15, 16]], [[2Pe.1.5-7|2Pe.1:5-7]]; in repetition for emphasis, [[Rom.3.21, 22; 9.30|Rom.3:21, 22, 9:30]], [[1Co.2.6|1Co.2:6]], [[Gal.2.2|Gal.2:2]], [[Php.2.8|Php.2:8]]; in transition to something new, [[Mat.1.18; 2.19|Mat.1:18, 2:19]], [[Luk.13.1|Luk.13:1]], [[Jhn.7.14|Jhn.7:14]], [[Act.6.1|Act.6:1]], [[Rom.8.28|Rom.8:28]], [[1Co.7.1; 8.1|1Co.7:1 8:1]], al.; in explanatory parenthesis or addition, [[Jhn.3.19|Jhn.3:19]], [[Rom.5.8|Rom.5:8]], [[1Co.1.12|1Co.1:12]], [[Eph.2.4; 5.32|Eph.2:4, 5:32]], al.; ὡς δέ, [[Jhn.2.9|Jhn.2:9]] καὶ . . . δέ, but also, [[Mat.10.18|Mat.10:18]], [[Luk.1.76|Luk.1:76]], [[Jhn.6.51|Jhn.6:51]], [[Rom.11.23|Rom.11:23]], al.; καὶ ἐὰν δέ, **yea even if**, [[Jhn.8.16|Jhn.8:16]]
2. Adversative, **but, on the other hand**, prop., answering to a foregoing μέν (which see), and distinguishing a word or clause from one preceding (in NT most frequently without μέν; Bl., §77, 12): ἐὰν δέ, [[Mat.6.14, 23|Mat.6:14, 23]], al.; ἐγὼ (σὺ, etc.) δέ, [[Mat.5.22; 6.6|Mat.5:22, 6:6]], [[Mrk.8.29|Mrk.8:29]], al.; ὁ δέ, αὐτὸς δέ, [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Luk.4.40|Luk.4:40]], al.; after a negation, [[Mat.6.19, 20|Mat.6:19, 20]], [[Rom.3.4|Rom.3:4]], [[1Th.5.21|1Th.5:21]], al.
(AS)

G1180.def:
**δεκατέσσαρες**, -ων, oἱ, αἱ, -α, τά
[in LXX: [[Gen.31.41|Gen.31:41]], [[Tob.8.19|Tob.8:19]], al. ;]
= cl. τεσσαρεσκαίδεκα, more frequently in later Gk. than the older form and in MGr. (for thirteen and upwards) universal, **fourteen**: [[Mat.1.17|Mat.1:17]], [[2Co.12.2|2Co.12:2]], [[Gal.2.1|Gal.2:1]] (cf. τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος).†
(AS)

G1165.def:
**δειγματίζω**
(δεῖγμα),
a rare word (_ICC_, ll. with), **to make a show of, to expose**: [[Mat.1.19|Mat.1:19]] (Rec. παραδ-, which see), [[Col.2.15|Col.2:15]]†
(AS)

G1135.def:
**γυνή**, -αικός, ἡ,
[in LXX for אִשָּׁה ;]
1. **a woman**, **married or unmarried**: [[Mat.11.11; 14.21|Mat.11:11 14:21]], al.; ὕπανδρος γ., [[Rom.7.2|Rom.7:2]] γ. χήρα, [[Luk.4.26|Luk.4:26]] in vocat., γύναι implies neither reproof nor severity, but is used frequently as a term of respect and endearment, [[Mat.15.28|Mat.15:28]], [[Jhn.2.4; 4.21; 19.26|Jhn.2:4, 4:21 19:26]].
2. **a wife**: [[Mat.1.20|Mat.1:20]], [[1Co.7.3|1Co.7:3]], 4 al.; γ. ἀπολύειν, [[Mrk.10.2|Mrk.10:2]], al.; γ. ἔχειν [[Mrk.6.18|Mrk.6:18]] γ. λαβεῖν, [[Mrk.12.19|Mrk.12:19]] γ. γαμεῖν, [[Luk.14.20|Luk.14:20]]
3. **a deaconess**, [[1Ti.3.11|1Ti.3:11]] (_CGT_, in l.).
(AS)

G1122.def:
**γραμματεύς**, -έως (accusative pl., -εῖς, see Bl., §8, 2), ὁ
(γράμμα), [in LXX always for שׁטר in Hex., elsewhere chiefly for ספר ;]
1. **a secretary**; γ. τ. πόλεως, **a state-clerk**: [[Act.19.35|Act.19:35]]
2. In π., of a military officer (Deiss., _BS_, 110f.). So [[Jdg.5.14|Jdg.5:14]], [[2Ki.25.19|4Ki.25:19]] (ספר), al.
3. **a scribe, a biblical scholar, teacher of the law** (so first in I [[Est.8.3|Est.8:3]], II [[Est.7.6|Est.7:6]]; in [[Luk.5.17|Luk.5:17]], νομοδιδάσκαλος; in [[Luk.10.25|Luk.10:25]], νομικός): [[Mat.7.29|Mat.7:29]], [[Mrk.1.22|Mrk.1:22]], and frequently in Gosp. γ. καὶ ἀρχιερεῖς, [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], and al.; γ. κ. Φαρισαῖοι, [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]], and al.; γ. μαθητευθεὶς τῇ βασιλείᾳ τ. οὐρ., [[Mat.13.52|Mat.13:52]] ποῦ σοφός; ποῦ γ., [[1Co.1.20|1Co.1:20]] (Cremer, 167; _DB_, iv, 420, 800).
(AS)

G1139.def:
**δαιμονίζομαι**
(in cl. also δαιμονάω; δαίμων), [in Aq.: [[Psa.91.6|Ps 90(91):6]] * ;]
**to be under the power of a δαίμων ** (δαιμόνιον, which see), **to be possessed**: [[Mat.15.22|Mat.15:22]] elsewhere always ptcp., -ιζόμενος, -ισθείς: [[Mat.4.24; 8.16, 28, 33; 9.32; 12.22|Mat.4:24; 8:16, 28, 33 9:32 12:22]], [[Mrk.1.32, 15, 16, 18|Mrk.1:32 15 16 18]], [[Luk.8.36|Luk.8:36]], [[Jhn.10.21|Jhn.10:21]] (Cremer, 171).†
(AS)

G1179.def:
**Δεκά-πολις**, -εως, ὴ
**Decapolis**, a region east of the Jordan con­taining ten cities: [[Mat.4.25|Mat.4:25]], [[Mrk.5.20; 7.31|Mrk.5:20 7:31]].†
(AS)

G1188.def:
**δεξιός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for יָמִין ;]
**the right**: [[Mat.5.29|Mat.5:29]], [[Jhn.18.10|Jhn.18:10]], al.; ὅπλα δ., weapons carried in the right hand, i.e. for offence, [[2Co.6.7|2Co.6:7]] ; ἡ δ. χείρ, [[Mat.5.30|Mat.5:30]], [[Luk.6.6|Luk.6:6]], al.; ἡ δ. (sc. χείρ), [[Mat.6.3|Mat.6:3]], al.; ἐπὶ τὴν δ., in the right hand (R, txt., _on_ R, mg.), [[Rev.5.1|Rev.5:1]] διδόναι τὴν δ., in friend­ship (Deiss., _BS_, 251), [[Gal.2.9|Gal.2:9]] metaphorically of power, τῇ δ. αὐτοῦ, [[Act.2.33; 5.31|Act.2:33 5:31]]; τὰ δ., **the right side**, [[Mrk.16.5|Mrk.16:5]] ἐκ δεξιῶν, **on the right hand**, with genitive, [[Mat.25.33, 34|Mat.25:33, 34]], [[Mrk.15.27|Mrk.15:27]], [[Luk.1.11|Luk.1:11]], al.; of a place of honour in the Messianic Kingdom (cf. [[3Ki.2.19|3Ki.2:19]], Psa.44(45):10), καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[Mat.20.21|Mat.20:21]], [[Mrk.10.37|Mrk.10:37]]; of the heavenly session of Christ, [[Mat.26.64|Mat.26:64]], [[Mrk.14.62|Mrk.14:62]], [[Heb.1.13|Heb.1:13]] (Cremer, 172)
(AS)

G1155.def:
**δανίζω**
(late form of cl. -είζω, Rec., Bl., § 3; Thackeray, _Gr._, 85f.) [in LXX chiefly for לוה ([[Pro.19.17|Pro.19:17]]) ;]
**to lend** money on interest: [[Luk.6.34, 35|Luk.6:34, 35]]; mid., **to borrow**: [[Mat.5.42|Mat.5:42]]†
_SYN._: κίχρημι (see: χράω), to lend in a friendly way. (AS)

G1169.def:
**δειλός**, -ή, όν
(δέος), [in LXX for רַךְ, etc. ;]
**cowardly, fearful**: [[Mat.8.26|Mat.8:26]], [[Mrk.4.40|Mrk.4:40]], [[Rev.21.8|Rev.21:8]].†
(AS)

G1142.def:
**δαίμων**, -ονος, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for גַּד, [[Isa.65.11|Isa.65:11]] (א; δαιμονίῳ, AB) * ;]
in cl. and NT = δαιμόνιον; **a demon**: [[Mat.8.31|Mat.8:31]]†
(AS)

G1116.def:
**Γόμορρα**, -ας, ἡ, and -ων, τά (Heb. עֲמֹרָה),
**Gomorrah**, one of the cities of the plain (Gen.19): [[Mat.10.15|Mat.10:15]], [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]]" (LXX), [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]], [[Jude.7|Ju 7]].†
(AS)

G1197.def:
**δέσμη** (Rec. δεσμή), -ης, ἡ
(δέω), [in LXX for אֲגֻדָּה, [[Exo.12.22|Exo.12:22]] * ;]
**a bundle**: δήσατε αὐτὰ εἰς δέσμας (D, Orig., omit εἰς, and Blass thinks original reading, δέσμας δέσμας; see Deiss., _LAE_, 125.4), [[Mat.13.30|Mat.13:30]]†
(AS)

G1163.def:
**δεῖ ** impersonal (δέω),
[in LXX chiefly for infin. with לְ ;]
**one must, it is necessary**: with inf., [[Mat.26.54|Mat.26:54]], [[Mrk.13.7|Mrk.13:7]], [[Act.5.29|Act.5:29]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[Mat.16.21|Mat.16:21]], [[Mrk.8.31|Mrk.8:31]], [[Jhn.3.7|Jhn.3:7]], [[Act.25.10|Act.25:10]], al.; with ellipse of accusative, [[Mat.23.23|Mat.23:23]] of accusative, and inf., [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]], [[Rom.1.27; 8.26|Rom.1:27 8:26]]; οὐ (μὴ) δεῖ (non licet), **ought not, must not**: [[Act.25.24|Act.25:24]], [[2Ti.2.24|2Ti.2:24]]; impf., ἔδει, of necessity or obligation in past time regarding a past event (Bl., § 63, 4), [[Mat.18.33|Mat.18:33]], [[Luk.15.32|Luk.15:32]], [[Jhn.4.4|Jhn.4:4]], [[Act.27.21|Act.27:21]], al.; periphr., δέον ἐστίν (as in Attic, χρεών ἐστι = χρή, see: δέον), [[Act.19.36|Act.19:36]] id., with ellipse of ἐστίν, [[1Pe.1.6|1Pe.1:6]] τὰ μὴ δέοντα (= ἃ οὐ δεῖ [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]]
_SYN._: ὀφείλει, expressing moral obligation, as distinct from δεῖ, denoting logical necessity and χρή, a need which results from the fitness of things (see Tr., _Syn._, § cvii, 10; Westc. on [[Heb.2.1|Heb.2:1]], [[1Jn.2.6|1Jn.2:6]]; Hort on [[Jas.3.10|Jas.3:10]]). (AS)

G1120.def:
**γονυπετέω**, -ῶ) (γόνυ, πίπτω);
1. **to fall on the knees**: before ἔμπροσθεν, [[Mat.27.29|Mat.27:29]]
2. **to fall down before** one: with accusative, [[Mat.17.14|Mat.17:14]], [[Mrk.1.40|Mrk.1:40]], R, txt., 10:17.
† (AS)

G1156.def:
**δάνιον**, -ου, τό
(late form of δάνειον, Rec.; see: δανίζω), [in LXX: [[Deu.24.11|Deu.24:11]] (נָשָׁה) 15:8, 10 (עָבַט hi.), [[4Ma.2.8|4Ma.2:8]] * ;]
**a loan**: [[Mat.18.27|Mat.18:27]]†
(AS)

G1111.def:
**γογγύζω**,
[in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;]
**to mutter, murmur**: [[1Co.10.10|1Co.10:10]] before κατά, [[Mat.20.11|Mat.20:11]] πρός, [[Luk.5.30|Luk.5:30]] περί, [[Jhn.6.41, 61|Jhn.6:41, 61]]; μετ᾽ ἀλλήλων, [[Jhn.6.43|Jhn.6:43]] with accusative, before περί, [[Jhn.7.32|Jhn.7:32]] (cf. δια-γογγύζω).†
(AS)

G1176.def:
**δέκα**, οἱ, αἱ, τά,
**ten**: [[Mat.20.24|Mat.20:24]], al.; θλίψις ἡμερῶν δ., i.e. of brief duration: [[Rev.2.10|Rev.2:10]]†
**δεκα-οκτώ**, T for δέκα ὀκτώ,
**eighteen**: [[Luk.13.4|Luk.13:4]]†
(AS)

G1124.def:
**γραφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(γράφω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּתָב ;]
1. **a drawing, painting**.
2.
(a) **writing**;
(b) **that which is written, a writing**: πᾶσα γ., [[2Ti.3.16|2Ti.3:16]] γ. ἅγιαι, [[Rom.1.2|Rom.1:2]] προφητικαί, [[Rom.16.26|Rom.16:26]] al αἱ γ. τ. προφητῶν, [[Mat.26.56|Mat.26:56]] ἡ γ., αἱ γ., **the sacred writings, the Scriptures** (i.e. the OT; see Milligan, **NTD**, 205); in pl., when the sacred writings as a whole are meant, e.g. [[Mat.21.42; 26.54|Mat.21:42 26:54]], [[Jhn.5.39|Jhn.5:39]], [[Rom.15.4|Rom.15:4]]; in sing., when a particular passage is referred to, as in [[Luk.4.21|Luk.4:21]], [[Jhn.19.24|Jhn.19:24]], [[Rom.4.3; 9.17; 10.11; 11.2|Rom.4:3 9:17 10:11 11:2]], [[Jas.2.23|Jas.2:23]] (Cremer, 165; _DCG_, ii, 584).
(AS)

G1195.def:
**δεσμεύω**
(δεσμός), [in LXX for אָסַר ([[Jdg.16.11|Jdg.16:11]], al.), אָלַם pi. ([[Gen.37.7|Gen.37:7]], al.), etc. ;]
1. **to put in chains**: [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]], [[Act.22.4|Act.22:4]].
2. **to bind, tie together**: φορτία, [[Mat.23.4|Mat.23:4]]†
(AS)

G1173.def:
**δεῖπνον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for פַּת־בַּג (Da) ;]
the chief meal of the day, **dinner, supper**: [[Mat.23.6|Mat.23:6]], [[Mrk.12.39|Mrk.12:39]], [[Luk.14.17, 24; 20.46|Luk.14:17, 24 20:46]], [[Jhn.13.2, 4; 21.20|Jhn.13:2, 4 21:20]], [[1Co.11.21|1Co.11:21]]; δ. ποιεῖν, [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]], [[Luk.14.12, 16|Luk.14:12, 16]], [[Jhn.12.2|Jhn.12:2]]; κυριακὸν (which see) δ., [[1Co.11.20|1Co.11:20]] metaphorically (Dalman, _Words_, 118), δ. τ. γάμου τ. ἀρνίου, [[Rev.19.9|Rev.19:9]] δ. τ. μέγα τ. Θεοῦ, [[Rev.19.17|Rev.19:17]]†
(AS)

G1158.def:
**Δανιήλ**, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. דָּנִיֵּאל, _God is my Judge_),
**Daniel**, **the prophet**: [[Mat.24.15|Mat.24:15]]†
(AS)

G1127.def:
**γρηγορέω**, -ῶ, = Attic ἐργήγορα, pf. of ἐγείρω, which see,
[in LXX (later bks. only) chiefly for שׁקד ;]
1. **to be awake**; metaphorically, of being alive, [[1Th.5.10|1Th.5:10]]
2. **to watch**: [[Mat.24.43; 26.38, 40|Mat.24:43 26:38, 40]] [[Mrk.13.34; 14.34, 37|Mrk.13:34 14:34, 37]] [[Luk.12.37|Luk.12:37]], 39; metaphorically, [[Mat.24.42; 25.13; 26.41|Mat.24:42 25:13 26:41]], [[Mrk.13.35|Mrk.13:35]], 37 14:38, [[Act.20.31|Act.20:31]], [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]], [[1Th.5.6|1Th.5:6]], [[1Pe.5.8|1Pe.5:8]], [[Rev.3.2, 3; 16.15|Rev.3:2, 3 16:15]]; before ἐν, [[Col.4.2|Col.4:2]] (Cf. δια-γρηγορέω).†
_SYN._: see: ἀγρθπνέω. (AS)

G1131.def:
**γυμνός**, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for עָרוֹם ;]
**naked, without clothing**, and sometimes (as frequently in cl.) **scantily** or **poorly clad** ([[Isa.20.2|Isa.20:2]]ff., [[Tob.1.16|Tob.1:16]], [[2Ma.11.12|2Ma.11:12]]): [[Mat.25.36, 38, 43, 44|Mat.25:36, 38 43, 44]], [[Mrk.14.52|Mrk.14:52]], [[Jhn.21.7|Jhn.21:7]], [[Act.19.16|Act.19:16]], [[Jas.2.15|Jas.2:15]], [[Rev.3.17; 16.15, 17:16|Rev.3:17 16:15, 17:16]]; as subst., to γ., **the naked body**, [[Mrk.14.51|Mrk.14:51]] Metaphorical, of things exposed, [[Heb.4.13|Heb.4:13]] of the soul without a body (Plat., _Crat._, with, 20, and cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 293), [[2Co.5.3|2Co.5:3]] of seed, **bare**, [[1Co.15.37|1Co.15:37]] (Cremer, 168).†
(AS)

G1170.def:
**δεῖνα**, ὁ, ἡ, τό (genitive -νος, dative -νι, accusative -να),
[in Aq.: [[Rut.4.1|Rut.4:1]], [[1Sa.21.2|1Ki.21:2]] (3) (Sm. also), [[2Ki.6.8|4Ki.6:8]] * ;]
**such an one, a certain one**, **whom one cannot or will not name**: [[Mat.26.18|Mat.26:18]]†
(AS)

G1115.def:
**Γολγοθά** (Rec. -θᾶ; WH, mg., Γολγόθ, Jo, l.with, Aram. גָּלְגָּלְתָּא = Heb. גֻּלְגֹּלֶת, LXX, κρανίον, [[Jdg.9.53|Jdg.9:53]], [[2Sa.9.35|2Ki.9:35]]); indecl. (exc. [[Mrk.15.22|Mrk.15:22]], -άν),
**Golgotha**, the place of the crucifixion: [[Mat.27.33|Mat.27:33]], [[Mrk.15.22|Mrk.15:22]], [[Jhn.19.17|Jhn.19:17]].†
(AS)

G1150.def:
**δαμάζω **
[in LXX: [[Dan.2.40|Dan.2:40]] (חֲשַׁל) * ;]
**to tame, subdue**: [[Mrk.5.4|Mrk.5:4]], [[Jas.3.7|Jas.3:7]]; metaphorically, τ. γλῶσσαν, [[Jas.3.8|Jas.3:8]] (Field, _Notes_, 237f.).†
(AS)

G1159.def:
**δαπανάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Tob.1.7|Tob.1:7]], [[1Ma.14.32|1Ma.14:32]], al. ;]
1. **to spend, expend**: with accusative, [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]] before ἐπί, with dative of person(s), [[Act.21.24|Act.21:24]] ὑπέρ, [[2Co.12.15|2Co.12:15]]
2. **to consume, squander**: [[Luk.15.14|Luk.15:14]] ἐν τ. ἡδσναῖς (on the constr. with ἐν, see Hort, Mayor, in l.), [[Jas.4.3|Jas.4:3]] (cf. ἐκ-, προσ- δ.).†
(AS)

G1199.def:
**δεσμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(δέω), [in LXX chiefly for אסר ;]
**a band, bond**: metaphorically, [[Luk.13.16|Luk.13:16]] ὁ δεσμὸς τ. γλώσσης, [[Mrk.7.35|Mrk.7:35]] (for this expression in π., see Deiss., _LAE_, 306 ff.; of actual bonds, see Ruth., _Gr._, 9). Pl., δεσμοί, [[Php.1.13|Php.1:13]] δεσμά (as also in cl.), [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]], [[Act.16.26; 20.23|Act.16:26 20:23]]; genitive, dative, [[Act.23.29; 26.29, 31|Act.23:29 26:29, 31]], [[Php.1.7, 14, 17|Php.1:7, 14, 17]], [[Col.4.18|Col.4:18]], [[2Ti.2.9|2Ti.2:9]], Phm 10, [[Heb.11.36|Heb.11:36]], [[Jude.6|Ju 6]]; ἐν τοῖς δ. τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Phm 13.†
(AS)

G1148.def:
**Δαλμανουθά**, ἡ
indecl.,
**Dalmanutha**, an unidentified place near the Sea of Galilee: [[Mrk.8.10|Mrk.8:10]] (cf. Μαγαδάν).†
(AS)

G1102.def:
**γναφεύς**, -έως, ὁ, Ion. and κοινή form of Att. κναφεύς
(κνάπτω, **to card** wool), [in LXX for כָּבַס, [[4Ki.18.17|4Ki.18:17]], [[Isa.7.3; 36.2|Isa.7:3 36:2]] * ;]
**a fuller, cloth-dresser**: [[Mrk.9.3|Mrk.9:3]]†
(AS)

G1119.def:
**γόνυ**, -ατος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for בֶּרֶךְ ;]
**the knee**: [[Heb.12.12|Heb.12:12]] of a suppliant, προσπίπτειν τοῖς γ., [[Luk.5.8|Luk.5:8]] so also τιθέναι τὰ γ., **to kneel**: [[Luk.22.41|Luk.22:41]], [[Act.7.60; 9.40; 20.36; 21.5|Act.7:60 9:40 20:36 21:5]]; in mockery, [[Mrk.15.19|Mrk.15:19]] κάμπτειν τὰ γ., **to bend the knee**: [[Rom.11.4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX) 14:11 (LXX), [[Eph.3.14|Eph.3:14]], [[Php.2.10|Php.2:10]].†
(AS)

G1162.def:
**δέησις**, -εως, ἡ
(δέομαι), [in LXX for תְּחִנָּה, רִנָּה, תְּפִלָּה, etc. ;]
1. **a wanting, need** (so [[Psa.22.25|Ps 21(22):25]]).
2. **an asking, entreaty, supplica­tion**; in NT always addressed to God: [[Luk.1.13|Luk.1:13]], [[2Co.1.11|2Co.1:11]], [[Php.1.19|Php.1:19]], [[2Ti.1.3|2Ti.1:3]], [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]], [[1Pe.3.12|1Pe.3:12]]" (LXX) ; with νηστεῖαι, [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]] προσυνχή, -αί, [[Eph.6.18|Eph.6:18]], [[Php.4.6|Php.4:6]], [[1Ti.2.1; 5.5|1Ti.2:1 5:5]]; ἱκετηρίαι, [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]] προσκαρτέρησις, [[Eph.6.18|Eph.6:18]] ἐντεύξεις, [[1Ti.2.1|1Ti.2:1]] δ. ποιεῖσθαι (Deiss., _BS_, 250), [[Luk.5.33|Luk.5:33]], [[Php.1.4|Php.1:4]] (pl.), [[1Ti.2.1|1Ti.2:1]] before ὑπέρ, [[2Co.9.14|2Co.9:14]], [[Php.1.4|Php.1:4]]; περί, [[Eph.6.18|Eph.6:18]] πρός, [[Rom.10.1|Rom.10:1]]†
_SYN._: προσευχή, used of prayer in general, while δ. gives prominence to the sense of need; on the other hand, δ. is used as well of requests from man to man, while π. is limited to prayer to God. ἔντευξις, in the π., is the regular word for _petition_ to a superior (Deiss., _BS_, 250; cf. the Pauline ἐντυγχάνειν, _to entreat_). Cf. also εὐχή. ([[Jas.5.15|Jas.5:15]]), αἴτημα, ἱκετηρία (Tr., _Syn._, § li; Cremer, 73, 174, 684). (AS)

G1108.def:
**γνῶσις**, -εως, ἡ
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;]
1. **a seeking to know, inquiry, investigation**.
2. **knowledge**, in NT, specially of the kn. of spiritual truth: absol., [[Luk.11.52|Luk.11:52]], [[Rom.2.20; 15.14|Rom.2:20 15:14]], [[1Co.1.5|1Co.1:5]] (Lft., _Notes_, 147) 8:1, 7, 10, 11, 13:2, 8 14:6, [[2Co.6.6; 8.7; 11.6|2Co.6:6 8:7 11:6]], [[Eph.3.19|Eph.3:19]], [[Col.2.3|Col.2:3]], [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]], [[2Pe.1.5|2Pe.1:5]], 6; with genitive obj., σωτηρίας, [[Luk.1.77|Luk.1:77]] τ. δόξης τ. θεοῦ, [[2Co.4.6|2Co.4:6]] τ. θεοῦ, [[2Co.2.14; 10.5|2Co.2:14 10:5]]; Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]] (see Deiss., _LAE_, 383.8), [[2Pe.3.18|2Pe.3:18]] with genitive subjc., θεοῦ, [[Rom.11.33|Rom.11:33]] λόγος γνώσεως, [[1Co.12.8|1Co.12:8]] ψευδωνύμου γνώσεως, [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]]
† _SYN._: σοφία, φρόνησις (cf. ἐπί-γνωσις and see Lft. on [[Col.2.3|Col.2:3]] Cremer, 156). (AS)

G1107.def:
**γνωρίζω**
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for ידע hi. ;]
1. as most commonly in cl., **to come to know, discover, know**: [[Php.1.22|Php.1:22]] (but cf. R, mg.).
2. **to make known**: with accusative, [[Rom.9.22, 23|Rom.9:22, 23]]; with accusative of thing(s) da.t. of person(s), [[Luk.2.15|Luk.2:15]], [[Jhn.15.15; 17.26|Jhn.15:15 17:26]], [[Act.2.28|Act.2:28]]" (LXX), [[1Co.15.1|1Co.15:1]], [[2Co.8.1|2Co.8:1]], [[Gal.1.11|Gal.1:11]], [[Eph.1.9; 6.19, 21|Eph.1:9 6:19, 21]] [[Col.4.7|Col.4:7]], 9 [[2Pe.1.16|2Pe.1:16]]; with dative, before ὅτι, [[1Co.12.3|1Co.12:3]] before τί, [[Col.1.27|Col.1:27]] περί, [[Luk.2.17|Luk.2:17]] Pass., [[Act.7.13|Act.7:13]], [[Rom.16.26|Rom.16:26]], [[Eph.3.3|Eph.3:3]], 6 10, [[Php.4.6|Php.4:6]] (Cremer, 677; cf. ἀνα-, δια-γνωρίζω).
† (AS)

G1110.def:
**γνωστός**, -ή, -όν, later form of γνωστός
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX for various parts of ידע ;]
**known**: [[Act.9.42|Act.9:42]] with dative, [[Jhn.18.15, 16|Jhn.18:15, 16]] (Rec.), [[Act.1.19; 2.14; 4.10; 13.38; 15.18; 19.17; 28.22, 28|Act.1:19 2:14 4:10 13:38 15:18 19:17 28:22, 28]]; γ. σημεῖον, **a notable** (EV) **sign**, one that is matter of knowledge, [[Act.4.16|Act.4:16]] γνωστὸν, [[Act.15.17, 18|Act.15:17, 18]]; τὸ γνωστὸν θεοῦ, [[Rom.1.19|Rom.1:19]] in pl., as subst., γνωστοί, **acquaintances**, [[Luk.2.44; 23.49|Luk.2:44 23:49]]; so in sing., [[Jhn.18.16|Jhn.18:16]] (WH).†
(AS)

G1184.def:
**δεκτός**, -ή, -όν
_verbal adj._ of δέχομαι, [in LXX chiefly for רָצוֹן: [[Pro.11.1|Pro.11:1]], al. ;]
**acceptable**: [[Luk.4.19|Luk.4:19]] (LXX) 24, [[Act.10.35|Act.10:35]], [[2Co.6.2|2Co.6:2]]" (LXX), [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]] (cf. εὐπροσδ-).†
(AS)

G1157.def:
**δανιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(late form of -ειστής, Rec.; see: δανείζω), [in LXX: [[4Ki.4.1|4Ki.4:1]], Psa.108(109):11 (נשׁה), [[Pro.29.13|Pro.29:13]] (רָשׁ), [[Sir.29.28|Sir.29:28]] * ;]
**a money-lender**: [[Luk.7.41|Luk.7:41]]†
(AS)

G1160.def:
**δαπάνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Est.6.4|Est.6:4]], 8 (נִפְקָא), [[Bel.1.21|Dan LXX Bel 1:21]], al. ;]
**expense, cost**: [[Luk.14.28|Luk.14:28]]†
(AS)

G1146.def:
**δακτύλιος**, -ου, ὁ
(δάκτυλος), [in LXX chiefly for טַבַּעַת ;]
**a ring**: [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]]†
(AS)

G1172.def:
**δειπνέω**, -ῶ
(δεῖπνον, which see), [in LXX: [[Pro.23.1|Pro.23:1]] (לחם), [[Tob.7.8; 8.1|Tob.7:8 8:1]], Dan LXX 11:27 * ;]
to take the chief meal of the day, **to dine, to sup**: [[Luk.17.8; 22.20|Luk.17:8 22:20]] (WH, br., R, mg. omits), [[1Co.11.25|1Co.11:25]] metaphorically, [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]]†
(AS)

G1182.def:
**δέκατος**, -η, -ον
(δέκα), [in LXX for מַעֲשֵׂר and cognate forms ;]
**tenth**: [[Jhn.1.40|Jhn.1:40]], [[Act.19.9|Act.19:9]] (WH, txt., RV omit), [[Rev.11.13; 21.20|Rev.11:13; 21:20]].†
(AS)

G1178.def:
**δεκα-πέντε **
[in LXX: [[Exo.27.15|Exo.27:15]], [[1Ma.10.40|1Ma.10:40]], al. ;]
late form of πεντεκαίδεκα, **fifteen**: [[Jhn.11.18|Jhn.11:18]], [[Act.27.5|Act.27:5]], WH, mg., ib. 28, [[Gal.1.18|Gal.1:18]].†
(AS)

G1145.def:
**δακρύω **
[in LXX for בָּכָה, etc. ;]
**to weep, shed tears**: [[Jhn.11.35|Jhn.11:35]]†
_SYN._: κλαίω, of audible weeping, **to cry**; ὀδύρομαι, of grief expressed verbally, **to lament**; θρηνέω, of formal lamentation, **to sing a dirge**; ἀλαλάζω, **to wail** in Oriental fashion; στενάζω, of grief expressed by inarticulate sounds, **to groan**. (AS)

G1101.def:
**γλωσσόκομον**, -ου, τό, vernac. form of cl. γλωσσοκομεῖον
(γλῶσσα, κομέω), [in LXX for אָרוֹן, [[2Ki.6.11|2Ki.6:11]], [[2Ch.24.8, 10, 11|2Ch.24:8, 10 11]] * ;]
1. = cl. -εῖον (see supr.), **a case** for holding the reeds or tongues of musical instruments.
2. As in LXX, π. (MM, see word), **a box, chest**: [[Jhn.12.6; 13.29|Jhn.12:6 13:29]].
† (AS)

G1168.def:
**δειλιάω**, -ῶ
(δειλία), [in LXX for חתת ni., פּחד, etc. ;]
= the more frequently ἀποδ-, **to be cowardly, timid, fearful**: [[Jhn.14.27|Jhn.14:27]]†
(AS)

G1174.def:
**δεισι-δαίμων**, -ον
(δείδω, to fear; δαίμων, _deity_)
**reverent to the deity, religious**; compar. -μονεστέρους (AV, _too superstitious_, R, txt., _somewhat superstitious_, a sense in wh. the word is sometimes used; cf. Field, _Notes_, 125), **more religious, God fearing**, than others, **quite religious** (Abbott, _Essays_, 105 ff.; Deiss., _LAE_, 285): [[Act.17.22|Act.17:22]]†
_SYN._: εὐσεβής (which see), θεοσεβής, θρῆσκος (Cremer, 681; _DB_, _ext._, 142 a). (AS)

G1187.def:
**δεξιολάβος**, -ου, ὁ
(δεξιός, λαμβάνω),
a kind of soldier, prob. **a spearman** (Vg., lancearius) or **slinger**: [[Act.23.23|Act.23:23]]†
**δεξιο-βόλος**, -ου, ὁ
(δεξιός, βάλλω),
**one who throws with the right hand**: L for δεξιολάβος, [[Act.23.23|Act.23:23]]†
(AS)

G1109.def:
**γνώστης**, -ου, ὁ
(γιγνώσκω), [in LXX chiefly for יִדְּעֹנִי ;]
**one who knows, an expert**: [[Act.26.3|Act.26:3]]†
(AS)

G1130.def:
**γυμνιτεύω** (Rec. γυμνητ-, V. Tdf ., _Pr._, 81),
**to be naked** or **scantily clad**: [[1Co.4.11|1Co.4:11]] (cf. ἐν ψύχει κ. γυμνότητι), [[2Co.11.27|2Co.11:27]] γυμνοί, [[Jas.2.15|Jas.2:15]] In κοινή writers, γ. also means **to go light-armed**.†
(AS)

G1103.def:
**γνήσιος**, -α, -ον
(γίγνομαι), [in LXX: [[Sir.7.18|Sir.7:18]], [[3Ma.3.19|3Ma.3:19]] * ;]
1. prop., **lawfully begotten, born in wedlock** (in π., γυνὴ γ., **a lawful wife**; MM, see word).
2. **true, genuine, sincere**: [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]], [[1Ti.1.2|1Ti.1:2]], [[Tit.1.4|Tit.1:4]]; as subst., τὸ γ. = ἡ γνησιότης, **sincerity**, [[2Co.8.8|2Co.8:8]]
† (AS)

G1143.def:
**δάκνω **
[in LXX for נשׁךְ, [[Gen.49.17|Gen.49:17]], al., exc. [[Deu.8.15|Deu.8:15]] (שׂרף) ;]
**to bite**: metaphorically, [[Gal.5.15|Gal.5:15]]†
(AS)

G1104.def:
**γνησίως**, _adv._,
[in LXX: [[2Ma.14.8|2Ma.14:8]], [[3Ma.3.23|3Ma.3:23]] * ;]
**sincerely, honourably**: [[Php.2.20|Phi 2:20]] (for a parallel in π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G1128.def:
**γυμνάζω**
(γυμνός), [in LXX: [[2Ma.10.15|2Ma.10:15]] * ;]
1. properly, **to exercise naked**.
2. Generally, **to exercise, train** the body or mind: [[1Ti.4.7|1Ti.4:7]], [[Heb.5.14; 12.11|Heb.5:14 12:11]], [[2Pe.2.14|2Pe.2:14]].
† (AS)

G1167.def:
**δειλία**, -ας, ἡ
(δειλός), [in LXX for אֵימָה, מְחִתָּה, etc. ;]
**cowardice, timidity** (never in good sense): [[2Ti.1.7|2Ti.1:7]]†
_SYN._: φόβος, _fear_, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly _pious fear_, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § x).† (AS)

G1133.def:
**γυναικάριον**, -ου, τό (diminutive of γυνή),
**a little woman**; contemptuously, **a silly woman** (EV): [[2Ti.3.6|2Ti.3:6]]†
(AS)

G1114.def:
**γόης**, -ητος, ὁ (γοάω, _to wail_),
1. **a wailer**.
2. **a wizard**.
3. **an impostor** (cf. γοητεία, _trickery_, [[2Ma.12.24|2Ma.12:24]]): [[2Ti.3.13|2Ti.3:13]].
† (AS)

G1149.def:
**Δαλματία** (L, Δελ-), -ας, ἡ
Dalmatia, a part of Illyria on E. coast of the Adriatic: [[2Ti.4.10|2Ti.4:10]]†
(AS)

G1183.def:
**δεκατόω**, -ῶ,
= cl. -τεύω (δεκάτη), [in LXX: [[Neh.10.37|Neh.10:37]] (38) (עשׂר pi.) * ;]
**to take tithe of**: with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.7.6|Heb.7:6]] pass. **to pay tithe**: [[Heb.7.9|Heb.7:9]]†
(AS)

G1151.def:
**δάμαλις**, -εως, ἡ
(fem. of δαμάλης, _a bullock_), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה, עֶגְלָה ;]
**a heifer**, [[Heb.9.13|Heb.9:13]]†
(AS)

G1192.def:
**δέρμα**, -τος, τό
(δέρω), [in LXX for עוֹר ;]
**the skin, hide** of beasts: ἐν αἰγίοις δ., [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]]†
(AS)

G1105.def:
**γνόφος** (later form of δν-),
[in LXX for אָפֵל, עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;]
**darkness, gloom** (including "an element of tempest," Tr., _Syn._, §with): [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]]†
_SYN._: ἀχλύς, ζόφος, σκότος (Tr., l.with; _DB_, i, 457a). (AS)

G1185.def:
**δελεάζω**
(δέλεαρ, _a bait_),
**to allure by a bait**: metaphorically, **to allure, entice**: with accusative, [[2Pe.2.14, 18|2Pe.2:14, 18]]; pass., [[Jas.1.14|Jas.1:14]]†
(AS)

G1164.def:
**δεῖγμα**, -τος, τό
(δείκνυμι);
1. (cl.) **a thing shown, a specimen**.
2. = cl. παράδ- (cf. ὑπόδ-, [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]]), **an example** (a warning): [[Jude.7|Ju 7]].†
(AS)

G1136.def:
**Γώγ**, ὁ (Heb. גּוֹג), indecl.,
**Gog**, assoc. with Magog (q.v): [[Rev.20.8|Rev.20:8]]†
(AS)
